name: Hermes Agent
short_desc: CLI-first AI agent: Web Terminal + Docker container. Gateway (Telegram/Discord), local models, persistent memory, self-improving skills
author: Nous Research
description: CLI-first AI agent framework with persistent memory, multi-platform gateway, and self-improving skills. The main interface is a **Web Terminal** (ttyd) running in your browser — full Bash shell access to the container. Optionally enable the built-in Dashboard UI for chat-based interaction.

form_fields.label: OpenRouter API Key
form_fields.hint: Get your key at https://openrouter.ai/keys (for cloud LLM access)

form_fields.label: Telegram Bot Token
form_fields.hint: Get from @BotFather on Telegram (for messaging gateway)

form_fields.label: Local Model URL
form_fields.hint: URL for local LLM server (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:1234/v1 for LM Studio)

form_fields.label: Enable Dashboard (Optional Web UI)
form_fields.hint: Add chat-based Dashboard UI at port 9120 (CLI terminal is always active on port 9119)

form_fields.label: Enable API Server
form_fields.hint: Enable OpenAI-compatible API server for OpenWebUI integration (requires API Server Key)

form_fields.label: API Server Key
form_fields.hint: Minimum 8 characters — required when Enable API Server is on (generate: openssl rand -hex 32)

form_fields.label: API Server Port
form_fields.hint: Port for the API server (requires Enable API Server)
